tei:div.tei:p: bid+yas+thānasarbadzñeyenanirāt+masādhakanāmas+yashās+t+robiharatisma/ /

༄༅/ /rig gnas kun shes nas bdag med grub pa zhes bya ba'i bstan bcos bzhugs/ / na mo mañdzu gho ṣā ya/ dpal ldan phun tshogs tshogs gnyis byed pos sprul| |rig gnas kun mkhyen mkhyen brtse'i gzi 'od 'bar/ /ma rig kun bcom bcom ldan nyi mar ni/ /btud nas kun rig rig gnas kun shes brtsams| |rig pa'i gnas lngar legs par ma sbyangs na/ /dgra bcom gyis kyang kun mkhyen thob mi srid/ /de bas don gnyis mthar phyin bya ba'i phyir/ / kun mkhyen lam 'dir mkhas rnams brtson par rigs/ /don gnyer rjes 'dzin bzo dang gso ba sbyang*/ /log smra tshar gcod sgra dang gtan tshigs te/ /phyi rol rig gnas bzhi dang nang gi don/ /thun mong min pa'i mdo sngags 'dir rig bya/ /lnga po re re'ang gsum gsum nyid du gnas/ /bzo ni lus dang ngag dang yid bzo'o/ /gso ba gso bya gso thabs gso ba po/ /sgra ni rang bzhin rkyen dang rnam 'gyur te/ gtan tshigs mngon gyur lkog gyur shin lkog 'jal/ / nang rig theg pa gsum du grags shing grub/ /de yang brjod bya nyan rang theg chen te/ /rjod byed thun mong ba dang de min la/ /shin tu rgyas pa'i mdo dang rgyud sde'o | | dang po bzhi yi gsum tshan thams cad kyang*/ /phyi rol pa la'ang tshang bar yod pa'i phyir/ /rig gnas thun mong ba zhes mkhas la grags/ /gal te phyi pa'i brjod bya rjod byed kun/ /skyon can nang pa'i de las bzlog pa'i phyir/ / thun mong nyid du 'thad pa min zhe na/ /ka lā pa ni slob phan dang bcas la/ /skyon can yin pa'i gtan tshigs ma grub cing*/ /gong ma gong ma'i rig pas cung zad tsam| |gnod pas thun mong zhes byar mi rigs na/ /dngos smra sde gsum nang par 'thad mi 'gyur/ /nang pa'i rig gnas bzhi pa ston pa'i gzhung*/ /sde bdun mdo dang bcas las gzhan med phyir/ /'di dag nang rig yin par 'dod rnams 'khrul/ /gsung rab spyi yi dgongs 'grel yin pa'i phyir/

/zer na sgra mdo kun kyang der 'gyur te/ /gsung rab kun gyi tshig gi dgongs 'grel phyir| |bstan dang ston la yid ches rnyed thabs dang*/ /bdag med ston dang de mkhyen ye shes ni/ /dngos stobs tshad mas 'grub sogs tshad ma mdo'i/ / mchod brjod don tsam rgyas par bshad pa ste/ /de ltar byas na yan lag brgyad pa dang*/ /tsan+d+ra pa dang rin chen 'byung gnas sogs/ /nang rig nyid du thal ba bzlog pa med/ /des na dngos bstan bstan bya'i gtso bo ni/ /gnas gsum gzhal bya rtog ge'i tshig don brgyad/ /yin phyir thun mong rig gnas nyid du bzung*| |dngos bstan bstan bya'i gtso bos mdo rgyud dang*/ /mdo la drang nges sde snod gsum dang ni/ /sngags la rgyud sde bzhi ru 'byed phyir ro/ /'khor ba kun las nges 'byung bsam pa dang*/ /bdag pas gzhan gces theg chen byang chub sems| |bden bzhi'i de nyid la sogs bdag med gnyis/ /phra rags bstan bya'i gtso bor gang mdzad pa/ /de ni nang rig nyid du legs par grub/ /rig gnas kun shes nas bdag med grub pa zhes bya ba'i bstan bcos las rig gnas spyir bshad pa'i le'u ste dang po'o// //rig gnas dang pos don gnyer rjes 'dzin te/ /bstan pa gnas phyir dkon mchog gsum gyi rten/ /bzhengs par 'dod pa'i 'byor ldan lhag bsam can| |rgyal bas bstan 'dzin nyid du lung bstan zhing*/ /gzhi ni tshangs pa'i bsod nams skyed byed de/ /sngar med gnas su rgyal ba'i ring bsrel mchog |bzhugs pa'i mchod rten brtsig par byed pa dang*/ /dge 'dun kun ra longs spyod dang bcas byed/ /dge 'dun bye ba legs par bsdum pa dang*/ / byams sogs tshad med bzhi po bsgom pa'o/ /zhes gsungs dang po gnyis po don gnyer la/ /bzo rig shes pas 'dod don sgrub pa tsam/ /smra mkhas grags pa can gyis mi 'grub cing*/ /chu chen brgal bar 'dod pa'i gru gzings dang*/ / gzhan phyogs 'joms pa'i 'phrul 'khor mtshon cha dang*/

/rang phyogs bsrung ba'i mkhar rdzong go cha dang*/ /gos bzang rgyan mchog bza' btung rol mo sogs| |dgos dgu mtha' dag 'di la rag las phyir/ /des na sgo gsum bzo la mi slob dang*/ khyad par 'dod chung chos mthun gtsor bzung nas/ /dge 'dun sde dang rten gsum 'gog byed pa/ /'di dag gcer bu'i grub mthas bslus par zad/ /rgyal bas 'dul ba lung gi gnas mal gzhir/ /gtsug lag khang dang de dbus dri gtsang khang*/ sgo khang khyams kyi thog 'bugs thog brtsegs dang*| |gnas khang so sor ri mo bri tshul sogs/ /rgya cher gsungs shing mdo sngags phal cher dang*/ khyad par shā ri'i bus zhus mdo dang ni/ /sdom 'byung dus 'khor sogs las sku gzugs dang*/ /mchod rten phyag tshad legs par gsungs pa bzhin/ /drang srong e ṭā'i bu yis byas pa yi/ /sku gzugs rnams kyi mtshan nyid ston pa dang*/ /dri med 'grel pa sogs las mchod rten dang*/ / sangs rgyas gsang bas mdzad par grags pa yi/ /blos slongs mtshan nyid gzhan yang bzo yi gnad/ /ston pa'i rgya bod gzhung la bslab par bya/ /lus ngag gtso bor byed dang mi byed las/ /lus ngag yid kyi bzo zhes gsum du dbye/ /lus bzo mchog ni sku gsung thugs kyi rten/ /sku la longs sku rang sor brgya dang ni/ / nyi shu rtsa lngar dus kyi 'khor lor gsungs/ /sprul sku rang sor brgya dang brgyad pa'am/ /bcu gnyis pa ru rig pas thob pa bzhin/ /gzhung lugs gzhan du 'byung ltar lag len byed/ /mi lus phal pa srid du gya bzhi dang*/ /zheng du go drug chu zheng mi mnyam gsungs/ /gzhan yang sprul sku la ni zhi khro dang*/ /rgyan dang phyag mtshan sogs kyi mtshan nyid do/ /gsung gi rten ni tshangs pa'i yi ge sogs| |yig rigs drug cu rtsa bzhir mdo las gsungs/ /lañtsha wartu la dang ngha ri dang*/ /na ga ra dang kha che'i yi ge sogs/ /rgya gar nyid kyi yig rigs du ma dang*| |bod dang rgya nag gru bzhi'i yi ge sogs/

/thugs kyi rten ni mchod rten zhes bya ba/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas la rnam kun yongs rdzogs te/ /shāka thub mchod rten brgyad du grags pa'o/ /rang sangs rgyas la char khebs med pa dang*/ /nyan thos 'bras bu bzhi la 'bras bu'i grangs/ /so so'i gdugs kyi rim pa bya ba dang*| |so skye la ni byi bo zhes bya ba/ /gdugs med bum pa'i steng du bre ldan te| |tshad ni dus 'khor dri med 'grel pa gnyis/ /so sor 'byung dang blos slongs phyag tshad sogs/ kho bos gzhung lugs gzhan dang khyad par du/ /rten gsum bzhengs tshul dpal 'byor rgya mtshor bshad/ /lus bzo phal pa khang khyim gru gzings dang*/ /shing rta la sogs 'phrul 'khor sna tshogs kyang*/ /dus 'khor rnam bshad kun tu rgyas par bshad/ /ngag bzo rgyal ba mchod pa'i bstod dbyangs dang*/ /gdug pa 'dul pa'i gad rgyangs nga ro drag /sna tshogs rol mo'i cha byad mtha' yas so/ /yid bzo thos dang bsam dang sgom pa'o/ /thos bsam bya ba'i yul ni mtha' yas te/ /brtag pa brgyad dang rig gnas bco brgyad dang*| |skar rtsis dbyangs char nag rtsis gso spyad sogs/ /sde snod gsum dang rgyud sde rnam bzhi ste/ /de dag bstan don zhi gnas lhag mthong sogs/ / yid bzo'i mchog gyur thar lam khyad par can/ /de phyir gnas 'dir rig gnas mtha' dag 'dus/ /de dag phal cher bshad zin 'chad par 'gyur/ / brtag pa brgyad ni rin chen sa gzhi gos/ /ljon shing rta glang pho mo brtag pa'o/ / phyi ma gnyis ni rgyud sde kun na gsal/ /sa gzhi brtag thabs dpal 'byor rgya mtshor bshad| |gzhan rnams 'khrul med bod du ma byon zhing*/ /rta dpyad la sogs bod kyi sbyar rnams la/ /rang bzo'i skyon mthong phyir na 'dir ma bshad/ / rtsis kyi rnam gzhag zur du bshad las shes/ /rig gnas kun shes nas bdag med grub pa zhes bya ba'i bstan bcos las bzo rig bshad pa ste le'u gnyis pa'o// // 'gro kun lus nad sna tshogs kyis gzir phyir/

/gso dpyad don du mi gnyer srid mtha' tsam/ /de phyir rig gnas gnyis pa 'di nyid ni/ /don gnyer rjes su 'dzin pa'i mchog tu grub/ /thub pa'i dbang pos rgya gar lho phyogs su/ / tshangs pas zhus ngor tshe yi rig byed kyi/ /sman rgyud 'bum phrag gsungs par mkhas la grags/ /gzhan yang rgyud sde spyi dang dus 'khor lo/ / sman gzhi'i lung dang gser 'od sogs su'ang gsungs/ /sgra gcan 'khor los tshangs pa'i dpral bar snad/ /de yi rkyen gyis tshe yi rig byed dran/ /skye rgu'i bdag la bshad cing de yis kyang*/ /tha skar bu gnyis brgya byin la sogs pa/ / lha yi drang srong rnams la brgyud nas ni/ /ston pa bzhugs dus rgyal po pad ma yi/ /snying po zhes bya'i yul ljongs rdo 'jog tu/ /mi yi drang srong rgyun shes bu las ni/ / gzugs can snying po'i zur bu tha chung po/ /'tsho byed gzhon nus gsod zhes cher grags pa/ /sman pa'i rgyal por lan mang dbang bskur cing*/ /thub pa snyun gso'i sman pa'i rgyal po byung*/ /de las brgyud pa gsal bar ma mthong yang*/ / lam 'di'i shing rta'i srol 'byed shes rab can/ /pha ma'i bran mdzad pha khol ma khol dang*/ /de gnyis ngag bcag lha chen bsgrub pa yis/ /pha gol ma gol zhes kyang mtshan du grags/ /phyi rol rig byed mkhas pa'i mthar son pas/ /mngal skyes sus kyang ma thub rig smra'i mchog /rdzus skyes 'phags pa lhas btul ston pa dang*/ /bstan la dad pa'i mchog gyur snyan ngag pa/ /phyi mo'i dbu ma par nges dpa' bo yis/ /phyi nang gzhung lugs zla med du ma brtsams| khyad par yan lag brgyad pa chen po sogs/ /sman dpyad mkhas pa dga' byed bzhi tsam mdzad| |de yi nang nas yan lag brgyad pa yi/ /snying po bsdus pa zhes bya 'di mdzad nas/ kha che zla dga' la bshad de yis kyang*/ /zla zer zhes bya'i rgya che 'grel pa mdzad/ /de nas legs brgyud lo chen skyes bu mchog

/rin chen bzang pos bsgyur bshad gtan la phab/ /mkhas pa du mar spel nas bod yul du| |rgya cher 'phel las bod kyi shing rta che/ /g.yu thog sogs kyis rgyud bzhir grags pa spel/ /gzhan yang rgya nag la sogs yul gzhan nas/ /thon pa'i sman dpyad du ma'ang yod mod kyi/ /gzhung gi mthar thug yan lag brgyad pa'o/ /'di yi gzhung tshad dgu stong bzhi brgya lhag /brjod bya yan lag brgyad y-in rjod tshul ni| |gnas drug le'u brgya dang nyi shu'o/ /brgyad ni lus spyi gso dang byis pa gso| |gdon gso lus kyi stod gso mtshon rmas gso/ /dug gso rgas pa gso dang ro rtsa gso/ /kun la gso ba'i yan lag ces sbyar brgyad/ /gnas drug mdo gnas lus gnas nad gzhi'i gnas/ /gso gnas cho ga grub gnas phyi ma'i gnas| |drug po rim bzhin le'u sum cu dang*/ /drug dang bcu drug nyer gnyis drug dang ni/ /bzhi bcu'o mdo gnas dang por gso ba'i dpyad/ /spyir bstan phyir na rtsa ba'i rgyud ces bya/ /lnga pa yan gyis de nyid 'chad pa'i phyir/ /bshad pa'i rgyud yin yan lag dang po ston/ /tha mas yan lag phyi ma bdun 'chad phyir| |phyi ma'i rgyud de rgyud gsum nyid du'ang gnas/ /'di dag la brten bod kyi rgyud bzhi la'ang*/ /rtsa rgyud bshad rgyud man ngag rgyud dang ni/ /phyi ma'i rgyud ces bya bar grags pa yin/ /gso bya'i nad rigs bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi zhes| |gzhan du grags pa rlung mkhris bad kan dang*/ /'dus pa bzhi la brgya rtsa re rer ni/ /phye bar gsal zhing bsdu na bzhi por 'dus/ /gzhung 'dir gso bya'i sgo nas brgyad nyid dang*/ /nad gzhi'i sgo nas bcu drug nyid du'ang gsal| |gzhan du bkres 'du'i nad ces gnyis su'ang bsdus/ /der ni sman yang rnam pa bzhir bsdus te/ /dus rung thun tshod rung dang zhag bdun pa/ /'tsho ba'i bar du bcang pa zhes bya'o/ /rgyud du rtsa rlung thig le'i nad gsum ste/

/rtsa chad rlung log dwangs ma nyams pa'o/ /der ni gso thabs gtso bor rnal 'byor te| |phal pa 'byor ldan phyi rol sman gyis dang*/ /kun spangs lus gnas sman gyis gso bar gsungs/ /'dir ni sman dang nad pa nad g.yog dang*/ /sman pa rnams la yon tan bzhi bzhir bstan/ /tha ma gnyis po gso ba por mtshungs pas| |gso ba'i brjod bya gsum du bsdus pa yin/ /gso dpyad byung tshul rnam thar rgyas pa dang*/ /spyi yi rnam gzhag lag len gces bsdus rnams/ /gzhan du bshad phyir 'dir ni de tsam mo/ /rig gnas kun shes nas bdag med grub pa zhes bya ba'i bstan bcos las gso ba rig pa bshad pa ste le'u gsum pa'o// // gsum pas tshig la 'khrul ba sel ba'i phyir/ /de la log par smra ba tshar gcod byed/ /sgra rig de bzhin gshegs pas gsung pa ni/ /nges tshig so so yang dag rig pa yi/ /yi ge dbri dang bsnan dang bsgyur ba dang*/ /tshig gi rnam dbye sogs kyi rnam 'gyur ro/ khyad par rnga bo che yi mdo las ni/ /byings dang ming dang kun bshad nye bsgyur dang*/ /kṛt dang de phan gyis bsdus grub pa rnams| |rgyal ba'i gsung rab las 'byung gsal bar gsungs/ /'jam pa'i dbyangs dang 'jig rten dbang phyug gis/ /dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbyangs gsal la brten pa'i/ /yi ge'i bsdu ba mdzad pa'i sgra yi mdo/ /yod par dbyangs 'char mdor bsdus thog mar gsal/ /tshangs pa rtag par zhi bas byas pa'ang yod| |brgya byin gyis byas in+d+ra byā ka ra/ /de la drang srong phur bus legs sbyangs pas/ /shin tu mkhas pa'i nga rgyal mchog tu gyur/ /nga rgyal brgya byin gyis bcom zhum nas ni/ /lha phran blo gsal mang la 'chad 'phro bzhag /da dung rang nyid sgra la sbyong bar zhus/ /nyan 'chad gnyis ka gyis zhes bkas bskul bas/ / dus bzang brgyad la gzhan la mi ston par/ /rang nyid slob pa'i sbyor la brtson pas na/ /nyan po gzhan gyis dus bzang bsrung dgos shar/

/de bzhin bram ze pā ṇi ni yis kyang*/ /rang ming ldan pa'i bstan bcos chen po sbyar/ /de la tsan+d+ra go mis bsdus pa yi/ /gzhung la tsan+d+ra par grags chos 'bangs kyis/ /byas pa'i 'grel pa dang bcas bod du 'gyur/ /dbang phyug go chas gzhon nu gdong drug bsgrubs/ /grub nas tshar gcig bstan pas tshig don rtogs/ /cha bsags ka lā pa yi mdo zhes bya/ /rang sde'i mkhas pa bgrod dka' seng ge yis/ /sbyar ba'i 'grel pa dur sing zhes bya dang*/ /gzhan sde jo bo drag 'byor gyis sbyar ba'i| |slob phan zhes bya'i 'grel pa'ang bod du byon/ /snga ma'i byings mdo yi ge'i mdo 'grel bcas/ /phyi ma'i byings mdo u ṇa 'grel par bcas/ /byings dang kun bshad dpung gnyen si sogs kyi/ /bya ba rgyas pa la sogs mang po dang*| |snga ma'i sub mtha' rin chen 'byung gnas sogs/ /sgra yi yan lag sdeb sbyor rin chen 'byung*/ /snyan ngag me long mngon brjod 'chi med mdzod| |kun tu dga' ba'i zlos gar la sogs pa/ /shong dpang yab sras rnams kyis bsgyur cing bshad/ /sgra dang snyan ngag sdeb sbyor mngon brjod dang*| |zlos gar rnams la rig gnas chung ngu'am/ /tha snyad rig pa'i gnas lngar grags pa rnams/ /chos rje sa paṇa yan la ma dar zhing*/ /thar lo yan la sgra mdo 'gyur ba med/ /sgra rig brjod bya spros te bshad na ni/ /sgra yi yan la thun mong gsum dang ni/ /thun mong min pa gsum zhes bya ba las/ /dang po ming dang tshig dang yi ge'o/ /mngon par yi ge du ma 'dus pa las/ /don gyi ngo bo tsam ston ming yin te/ /de 'dus khyad par ston pa tshig yin la/ /yi ge gnyis po de yi bsgrub gzhi byed/ /dngos smra'i lugs la'ang rig pas dpyad bzod ni/ /yi ge'i cha shas skad cig re re ste/ /gzhan rnams rgyun yin ldan min 'du byed do| |'di la mkhas rlom kha cig 'di skad du/ kha yig gcig nyid rgya skad nam mkha' dang*/

/bod skad smra ba'i bu ga'i ming yin phyir/ /ming la yi ge 'dus pas ma khyab la/ kha yig srog tu a yig ma zhugs na/ /brjod du mi rung tshul la rmongs par zad/ /'dir ni yi ge re res don ston te/ /a i u rnams lha re'i ming yin phyir/ /'dir yang ming tshig 'gal te tshig yin la/ /si sogs ti sogs gang rung mtha' can yin/

/ming ngam rtags ni de 'jug gzhi yin phyir| |yi ge'i ngo bo skad kyi gdangs yin te/ /thung mtha' skyes bu dar ma'i mig 'dzum tshad/ /gcig yun de yin ring po gnyis yun dang*/ /gsum yun la sogs shin tu ring po'o/ / gzugs ni lañtsha dha ri la sogs te/ /byed las ming tshig brjod pa kun gyi gzhi/ /nges tshig ak+ṣa ra dang byāñdza dang*/ /war+ṇa zhes pa gzhan du mi 'gyur dang*/ /ming tshig gsal dang don rnams brjod byed do/ /dbye bsdu sgra pas dbyangs yig bcu bzhi dang*/ /gsal byed so gsum dbyangs gsal min pa'i bzhir/ /dbye zhing bsdu na dbyangs gsal gnyis min gsum| |ring thung shin tu ring po zhes pa gsum/ /dbyangs la 'byed cing l̥ yig ring po med/ /mtshams sbyor yi ge thung ngu med pas na/ /de lnga las gzhan dbyangs la gsum gsum dbye/ /re re'ang mtho dma' bar pa gsum gsum dang*| |re re'ang sna ldan sna med gnyis gnyis dbye/ /dus kyi 'khor lor rang byung yi ge lnga/ /a i ṛ u l̥ zhes bya ba yin/ /de yi ring po yon tan 'phel ba rnams| |lnga lnga ya ṇar bsgyur ba ha sogs lnga/ /ring thung phye bas dbyangs yig sum cu ste/ /a yig thig le can dang tsheg drag can/ /gnyis bsnan dbyangs yig so gnyis zhes kyang bshad/ / gsal byed sde pa lnga dang pa sde ste/ /sum cur byas pa mang zhing ha sde dang*/ /ḍha sde zhes pa'ang bsnan pas bzhi bcur gsungs/ /sngags gzhan dbyangs gsal bcu drug so bzhi ste/ /dbyangs la ring thung sbyar bas bcu drug dang*/ /gsal byed ḍa sogs drug bsnan bzhi bcu po| |phrag gnyis dpe byad brgyad cur byas pa'ang gsungs/ /rgyu ni brjod 'dod rlung dang gnas rnams dang*/ /byed pa lce rkan las skyes phal cher te/ /rnga sgra'i gdangs sogs gzhan las skyes pa'ang yod/ /yi ge'i gtso bo 'bru gsum rlung gdangs ni/ /byed pa lce rkan gnas la mi bltos so/ /klog tshul dbyangs gsal so so dag las bslab/

/ming la thog ma'i ming dang rjes grub ming*/ /'di gnyis rim bzhin dngos ming btags ming yin/ /mtshan nyid rgyu mtshan med pa'i 'dod rgyal dang*/ /'dra 'brel rgyur byas phyi nas sbyar ba zhes/ /zer ba rnams la sangs rgyas zhes pa'i sgra/ /dngos ming min par thal ba'i gnod pa yod| |des na rgyu mtshan med dam yod kyang rung*/ /dang por sbyar bas de la 'khrul med dang*/ /'dra 'brel rgyur byas gzhan la'ang 'jug rung yin/ /tshig gi khyad par snyan ngag sdeb sbyor te/ /dang po bcad lhug spel ma gsum du bshad// tshigs bcad rkang bzhi pa ste de la yang*/ /yi ge bgrang zhing mnyam pa bṛt dang*// phyi mo bgrang zhing mi mnyam dzā ti'o/ /de gnyis sdeb sbyor ming yin dang po la// yi ge nyer drug man chad tshigs bcad dang*/ /rkang pas bcad pa'i yi ge bgrang mod kyang*/ /nyer bdun yan la rgyun chags zhes byar bshad/ /bṛt mnyam dang phyed mnyam mi mnyam gsum/ /dzā ti 'phags pa ro langs phyi mo mnyam/ /snyan ngag tshigs bcad la yang grol mdzod 'dus/ /rim bzhin rkang pa gcig dang tshigs bcad gcig /tshigs bcad du mas don gcig ston pa'o/ /le'us bcings pa snyan ngag chen po dang*/ /ma bcings snyan ngag chung ngu'i tshigs bcad yin| |rkang pa med pa'i tshig rgyun lhug pa ste/ /brjod dang gtam zhes bya ba gnyis su dbye/ /spel ma'am gcam bu zlos gar bstan bcos yin/ /de gsum legs sbyar la sogs skad bzhir dbye/ /rgya gar lho dang shar ba'i snyan ngag la// be dar+bha ba dang gau ḍa ba zhes bya/ /sbyar ba rab dwangs mnyam nyid la sogs bcu/ / dang po'i rgyan yin bzlog pa gnyis pa'i rgyan/ /thun mong don rgyan sum cu rtsa lnga dang*| |sgra rgyan zung ldan bya dka' bya sla dang*/ /gab tshig bzhi ste dang po bar ma chod| |bar chod zung ldan che dang lugs ldog dang*/ /bya dka' ba glang gcin dang phyed 'khor dang*/ /kun 'khor kun tu bzang po zhes byar grags/

/bya sla dbyangs gnas yi ge ma nges gsum/ /gab tshig kun tshogs bslu med sogs bcu drug /mngon brjod du ma'i don la ming gcig nyid/ /'jug pa ngag phyogs sa dang 'od zer dang*/ /phyugs sogs bcu la go sgra nyid 'jug dang*/ /don gcig nyid la du ma'i ming 'jug pa/ /nyi ma nyid la rta ljang tsha zer can/ /nam mkha'i nor bu pad+ma'i gnyen sogs so/ /thun mong min par rang bzhin rkyen rnam 'gyur| |rang bzhin byings dang ming yin byings la yang*/ /byings mdo le'u dgu nas bshad rnams la/ /glegs bam nas byung zhes zer 'grel pa yis/ / zur nas rnyed rnams mdo yi byings su grags/ /byings mthar san sogs drug po byin nas kyang*/ /byings su gnas rnams rkyen gyis bcod pa'i byings/ /ming ni lugs 'dir rtags su grags pa ste/ /byings la rkyen byin rnam dbye ma sbyin pa'i/ /bar skabs sgra yi yan lag ming ngam rtags/ /dbye na pho mo ma ning so so ba| |gsum dang thun mong ba ste ming bzhi zer/ /rkyen la mtshan nyid rang bzhin rnam 'gyur du/ /sgrub par byed pa'i sgra yi yan lag zer/ /dbye na bdun te byings la kṛt kyi rkyen/ /sbyar bas byings ni rtags su sgrub pa'i rkyen/ /byings la ti sogs sbyar ba tshig tu sgrub/ /byings la san sbyar byings nyid byings su sgrub/ / rtags la mo rtags sbyar ba rtags nyid rtags/ /rtags la de phan rkyen sbyar ming nyid ming*/ /rtags la yin sogs sbyar ba rtags nyid byings/ /rtags la si sogs sbyar ba rtags tshig tu/ /sgrub par byed pas rkyen gyi sde tshan bdun/ /rnam 'gyur rang bzhin rkyen dang 'brel pa'am/ yi ge tsam dang 'brel ba'i bsgyur dbye ste/ /yan lag so so ba'i dang phrad pa las/ /gyur pa'i rnam par 'gyur ba gnyis su bsdu/ /dang po sbyar ba ming dang ā ga ma/ /sbyar min rjes 'brel zhes grags mi gnas te/ rjes 'brel tsam dang brjod don ngo bo'i don/

/dang po byings rkyen rtags dang ā ga ma/ /mi zad pa dang tshig gi rjes 'brel lo/ /ā ga ma ni glo bur ba zhes bya/ /des na dus gnas gar yod mi shes par/ /thol byung dkyus min dgos ldan rtags kyi don/ /phrad gyur spyi dang byings rkyen phrad pa dang*| |tshig gnyis phan tshun phrad las gyur pa yi/ /rnam par 'gyur pa'i dbye ba mtha' yas phyir/ /legs sbyar gzhung dang kho bos sbyar ba yi/ /spyi don nyid du gsal phyir blang bar mdzod/ /rig gnas kun shes nas bdag med grub pa zhes bya ba'i bstan bcos las sgra rig pa bshad pa ste le'u bzhi pa'o// // bzhi pas don la 'khrul rnams tshar gcod phyir/ /lta ba ngan pa mtha' dag 'joms par nus/ /gtan tshigs rig pa rgyal bas gsungs pa ni/ /mig gi rnam par shes pa sngon po tsam/ /shes kyi sngon po 'o zhes ma yin zhes/ / gsungs pas mngon sum rtog bral dbang mngon bstan/ /gzugs la gsal snang shes pa gnyis yin te/ /mig dang yid do zhes pas yid mngon bstan/ / 'dis ni chos la gsal snang yod pa tsam/ /yid mngon yin par smra ba rnams kyang bkag /dmigs myong so sor bshad pas rang rig dang*/ /bdag med gsal snang gsungs pa rnal 'byor te/ /mngon sum bzhi ga ston pas gsal bar gsungs/ /gang zhig 'dus byas yin pa de mi rtag /du ba las ni mer shes dper mdzad pas/ /rang bzhin 'bras bu'i gtan tshigs de bzhin du/ /tshad mas ma dmigs pa de med ces dang*/ /gang zag tsam gyis gang zag tshod mi bzung*| |zhes pas mi dmigs pa gnyis gsal bar bstan/ /de bzhin dgra bcom chos skyob me waṃ ga /kun mkhyen gnyis pas rtsod sgrub snga dus mdzad/ / des bskyangs 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis rjes bzung ba/ /rig smra'i gtso bo phyogs kyi glang po yis/ /gzhung mang mdzad las btus nas tshad ma'i mdo/ /mngon sum rjes dpag gnyis dang gzhan sel dang*/ /dpe dang rtag chod le'u drug ldan mdzad|

|'grel byed tshad mar ma gyur 'gas kyang bshad/ /rgyal bas lung bstan chos grags nyi ma yis/ /mdo yi pad mo rnam par rgyas byed pa'i/ /sde bdun tsha zer phyogs bcur spros par gyur/ /de yang gtso bor rgyal ba'i bstan bcos kyi/ /mchod brjod bshad pas ston dang bstan pa la/ /shes nas dad pa rgyas byed le'u gcig /mngon sum grangs nges 'bras bur bcas la gcig / gzhan sel dpe dang bcas pa bsdus pa yis/ /gtan tshigs gtsor ston rang don rjes dpag dang*/ /rtag chod shugs ston gzhan don rjes dpag gis/ /mdo yi brjod bya mtha' dag rnam par 'grel/ /mngon rjes le'u gsum po rang gi lugs| |'bring dang bsdus pa rnam nges rig thigs te/ /rtsa ba lus dang 'dra ba gsum zhes grags/ /'grel dang tshul gsum sgrub ngag ltar snang dang*/ /rang blo lkog gyur 'gog las 'phros nas ni/ /'brel brtag gtan tshigs thigs pa rtsod rig dang*/ /rgyud gzhan grub las 'phros pa yan lag zer/ /rnam 'grel le'u dang po rnam nges dang*/ /'brel brtag rnams la nyid kyis rnam bshad mdzad| |le'u dang 'grel rjes dpag bstan bcos ni/ /'chad sgyur gsungs pas le'u dang por grub/ /bram zes mthong ba blos bslad man chad la/ /'grel bshad ma byas phyi na de man chad/ /rang 'grel min zhes zer mod lha rgyan gyis| |le'u gzhan gsum nyid las ma bshad phyir/ /dang po'i smad la 'grel pa med par 'gyur/ /shākyas rang 'grel nyid du bshad phyir yang*/ /rgyan gyi rjes 'brang rgyal ba can dang ni/ /ya mā ri dang nyi ma sbas pa'o/ /rgyal rnga gsum pas rnam nges rig thigs kyi/ /rgya cher 'grel byas zhi 'tshos de nyid bsdus/ /ka ma la yis de 'grel tshad chen byas/ /gzhan yang bram ze che dang dzñā na shrī/ /dul lha tsan+d+ra go mi dze tā ri/ /dge bsrungs sogs kyi gzhung phran mang po yod/ /snga dar dus su sde bdun phyi ma 'ga'/ /phyi dar rma rngog sa paṇa sogs kyis bsgyur/

/ brjod bya gsum gyi gzhal bya mngon gyur ni/ /tshur mthong dbang byas phyi rol gzugs sogs lnga/ /shes pa'i steng gi myong cha tsam du zad/ /'phags la bdag med gnas lugs mngon gyur nyid/ /kun mkhyen la ni shes bya ji snyed pa'ang*/ / mngon gyur yin zhes mkhas rnams smra mod kyi/ /chos kyi grags pas bsam mi khyab par gsungs/ /ka bum gang zag sogs kyang tshur mthong la/ /mngon gyur yin zhes bod na grags mod kyang*/ /de dag gzugs mthong tsam la gang zag sogs| |mngon sum mthong zhes byis la grags mod kyi/ /ldan min 'du byed dbang pos mthong mi srid/ /des na rang gi mtshan nyid kyis grub pa'i/ /dngos po rig pas dpyad bzod bden grub ni/ /mngon gyur nyid du dngos smras gsum ga mthun/ /rgyun dang rags pa yan lag can kun la/ /rang sde kun gyis bden 'dzin bzlog phyir ro/ /gzhal bya 'di yi 'jal byed mngon sum bzhi/ /lkog gyur dbang po gzugs can mi rtag sogs/ /rnam pa bcu drug bdag gcig de byung 'brel/ /nus pa sa bon spang gnyen la sogs te/ /dngos stobs gtan tshigs nyid kyis sgrub dgos phyir/ /sgrub byed gtan tshigs de ni rnam gsum ste// 'bras bu rang bzhin ma dmigs zhes bya'o/ /'bras rtags mthun dpe du ldan tshang mang du/ /me du'i rgyu 'bras nges byed phrugs gsum las/ /der nges la khar du ba mngon sum mthong*/ /phyogs der me la shes 'dod zhugs pa na/ /sngar gyi khyab 'brel dran pa'i rtags sems kyi/ /bsgrub bya nges pa'i rjes dpag skyes pas na/ /rgyu 'bras nges pa'i lung rtogs 'bras bu ni/ /mngon sum grub pas rang rgyu gsal bar rtogs/ /rgyu yi khyad par sgrub pa'i 'bras rtags kyi/ /dbang shes rkyen gsum la sogs sgrub par nus/ /tshogs pa gcig la rag lus 'brel shes na/ /du bas bud shing 'gyur ba rtogs pa bzhin/ /gzugs sogs ro la sogs pas rtogs pa ni/

/rgyu yi nus pa rjes su dpog pa'o/ /rang bzhin sgra sogs 'dus byas skad cig mar/ /byas dang dngos yod rtags kyis sgrub pa ste| |rig byed sgra sogs rtag par smra ba la/ /byas par 'dod phyir ma byas par thal zhes/ /mi 'dod thal bar 'phangs nas rtag phyir gyi/ khas blangs ngan pa rtags su bkod nas ni/ /rtag la rkyen gyis byas pa mi srid phyir/ /byas na 'jig rgyu gzhan la ltos med kyi/ /rig pa bstan pas lan gyis ma bzlog nas// the tshom skyes tshe gang byas mi rtag ste/ /bum pa ji bzhin sgra yang byas zhe'am/ / ldog khyab mi mthun sbyor ba bkod pa na/ /gdul bya mi rtag lam la 'god par nus| |'di la ltos ngag dbye ba gnyis su gsungs/ /ma dmigs pa la mi snang ma dmigs dang*/ /snang rung ma dmigs gnyis te dang po ni/ /med par ma nges rtags dang mngon sum gyis/ /yod par mi 'grub shin tu lkog gyur don/ /de ltar gyur pas yod nges mi 'jug ste/ /de yi mngon rjes tshad mas ma grub phyir| |'dis ni gzhan rgyud chags sdang khyad par sogs/ kha tshon gcod rnams glen chen nyid du bstan/ /gnyis pa phung po las gzhan bdag med de/ /de 'dra snang rung tshad mas ma dmigs phyir/ /'di ni phung po dag pa dmigs pas na// de mi dmigs pa'ang mngon sum nyid kyis 'grub/ /'di la 'brel zla ma dmigs pa dang ni/ /'gal zla dmigs pa'i dbye ba du ma yod/ /shin lkog dge sdig las 'bras phra mo dang*/ /bde 'gro ngan 'gro'i gnas dang 'gro ba dang*// de dag bde sdug tshe tshad lus tshad sogs/ /'jal byed dpyad gsum gyis dag lung nyid la/ /brten pa'i yid ches rjes dpag ces bya'o/ /dpyad pa gsum ni mngon gyur ston rnams la/ /mngon sum gyis dang lkog gyur ston pa la/ /dngos stobs rjes dpag shin lkog ston rnams la/ /rang tshig snga phyi 'gal bas mi gnod pa'o/ /de dag zhib tu 'dir bshad tshig mang zhing*/

/rgyas par rig pa'i gzhung du bshad zin phyir/ /de dag nyid las rgya cher rtogs par bya/ /rig gnas kun shes nas bdag med grub pa zhes bya ba'i bstan bcos las tshad ma rig pa bshad pa ste le'u lnga pa'o// // nang rig nges 'byung mchog dang byang chub sems/ /rnam grol gsum gyi lam mchog ston pa ste/ /grol pa thar pa rnam grol lus zhes pa'i/ /lus rnams grol zhes bya bar gnas pa ste/ /nyon mongs pas ni sems dkrugs nyon sgrib las/ /grol ba nyan rang gnyis kyi myang 'das so/ /mi shes 'dam du bying ba shes sgrib las/ /thar pa phar phyin theg pa'i sangs rgyas yin/ /bla med 'bras bu lus sgrib phra mo las/ /rnam par grol ba mthar thug sangs rgyas so/ /rjod byed sde snod gsum dang rgyud sde bzhi/ /sngags la'ang bslab gsum ston rnams sde snod gsum/ /yin phyir sde snod zur pa min zhe na/ /dpal ldan gsang ba 'dus pa'i rtsa rgyud ni/ /mdo sde chos phung brgyad khri bzhi stong gi /snod dang rgyud sde sum khri sum stong gi /rtsa bar gsungs pas snod dang rtsa ba'i khyad/ /phye phyir rig pa 'dzin pa'i sde snod ces/ /bzhi par rgya bod mkhas rnams bzhed bar 'thad| |gsum ni 'dul ba mdo sde mngon pa ste/ /lhag pa'i tshul khrims sems dang shes rab kyi/ /bslab gsum bstan bya'i gtso bor mdzad pa'o/ /'dul ba gzhi dang rnam 'byed phran tshegs dang*/ /dam pa zhes bya 'dul lung sde bzhi yin/ /dang po gnyis la glegs bam bzhi bzhi ste/ /phyi ma gnyis la gnyis gnyis tha ma la/ /zhu ba 'dul byed gtam dang gleng gzhi dang*/ /sil bu la sogs 'dul phran du ma bzhugs/ /mdo sde theg chung dran pa nyer gzhag dang*| |mdo mang phran tshegs mang po 'dul lung gi /brjod bya thor bu khyad par ba rnams la/ /gleng gzhi yi rangs dang bcas zur bkol yin/ /theg chen shin tu rgyas pa'i mdo sde ni/ /phal cher dkon brtsegs sprin chen rnga bo che/

/myang 'das che sogs 'khor lo tha ma dang/ /bar pa sher phyin 'khor dang bcas pa'o/ /mngon pa theg chung sde bdun du grags te/ /theg chen stong phrag brgya pa dga' ldan na/ /bzhugs shing gzhan rnams lan gsum brlag ces grags/ /

rgyud sde gdul bya dman 'bring chen po dang*/ /chen po'i chen po rnams la rim bzhin du/ /bya spyod rnal 'byor rnam 'byor bla med gsungs/ /'di dag gzhung tshad brjod bya la sogs pa/ / gsang sngags spyi dang mdo phyogs brjod tshul rnams| |mang bas 'jigs shing gzhan du bshad pa'i phyir/ 'dir ni mdo tsam bsdus mod gzhan du rtogs/ /rig gnas kun shes nas bdag med grub pa zhes bya ba'i bstan bcos las nang rig bshad pa ste le'u drug pa'o// //de ltar lnga rig nyer mkho bsdus pa 'dis/ /lde mig byas te rig gnas mtha' dag gi/ bang mdzod mthong nas bsam 'phel nor mchog gis/ /'gro kun blo mun sel ba'i dpal thob shog /ces stag tshang gi dge slong lo tsā ba shes rab rin chen rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos gser 'phyang zhes bya ba me mo bya'i sa ga'i dkar phyogs kyi rgyal ba dang po la chos 'khor sgang du sbyar ba'o// //swasti/ rje btsun chos kyi rgyal po stag tshang ba'i*/ /zhabs pad dri med mchog la rab btud nas/ /gang des mdzad pa'i rig gnas kun shes kyi/ /rtsa 'grel phul byung spar du grub tshul ni/ /rje de'i bya ba las kyi kha lo ba/ /nye gnas chen po lha yi dpal bzang kyis/ /bdag rkyen bgyis nas bris la rab mkhas pa/ /tshul khrims 'phel gyis legs par bris pa la/ /dge slong grub pa rgyal mtshan brda sprod pas/ /zhus dag byas shing brkos la rab mkhas pa/ /chos kyi bzang pos khro mo zhes bya ba/ /shing pho 'brug lo gro zhun gyis nya'i nyin/ /dge 'phel chos 'khor sgang du spar du grub/ /grub 'di'i spar shing pho brang rtse nas phul| |phul byung 'thun rkyen bla brang shar nas sbyar/ /sbyar ba'i dge ba rta ljang dbang po des/ /thub bstan gling bzhi'i ma rig mun bcom nas/ /rig gnas pad dkar skyed tshal rab brgyas ste/ /bstan 'dzin bung ba sbrang rtsis tshim pa dang*| |stag tshang lo tsā'i thugs dgongs yongs rdzogs shog/

//ye dharmā he tu pra bha wā he tu n+teṣān+ta thā ga to h+ya wang ta/ te ṣāñtsa yo ni ro dha e waṃ wā dī ma hā shra ma ṇaḥ //maṃ ga laṃ bha wan+tu// shu bhaṃ// mes po'i shul bzhag las/ stag tshang lo tsā ba shes rab rin chen gyi bka' 'bum/rig gnas kun shes nas bdag med grub pa zhes bya ba'i bstan bcos/ -PAGE 2--PAGE 9-- PAGE 1-
